comments.text: From the sacred mountain Gangkhar Puensum that no one is allowed to climb, to an entire village celebrating their birthdays together on New Year's... Bhutan truly teaches the world a lesson about respecting nature and community bonding. In a materialistic world, Bhutan proves that some sacred things cannot be priced. What an amazing documentary! 🙏✨
